zh-CN.title: 宽屏奖励改用左侧纵向轨道
items: 桌面宽屏下奖励列表移动到主预览左侧
奖励改为纵向滚动并自动垂直居中
手机端继续使用底部横向轨道

en.title: A vertical reward rail for wide screens
items: The reward list now sits to the left of the main preview on wide desktop screens
Rewards scroll vertically and center automatically
Mobile keeps the bottom horizontal rail
